components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific for the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it is combined with the lastName to form the
            salutation. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When a
            non-blank value is supplied the structured form is preferred over the
            flat 'address' input. Normalized on create (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create the same way as addressLine1 and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility, but when structured fields are supplied
            (a non-blank addressLine1) it is derived and returned as the
            composed value: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and
            the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits; the result must have 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. The E.164 string (e.g. '+61412345678') is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The effective date must fall on a business day: if it lands on
            a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the following Monday, and
            that adjusted date is what is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the owner's ageBand,
            computed against the effective registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW
            2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall
            within that region's inclusive range. A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only opt-in flag for create. The household is keyed on
            (lastName, postcode), so a second owner sharing an existing owner's
            lastName and postcode is a household duplicate and is rejected 409.
            When true this flag bypasses that block, creating the owner as a
            declared household member (which is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate). It does not itself create the household link — the shared
            householdId is derived deterministically from lastName and postcode.
            Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner API response shape. Fixed at 2: the
                identifiers are grouped under the nested 'identity' object and
                are derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, derived on read as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read: the title followed by a
                single space and the lastName when a title is supplied, otherwise
                just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived on read; the raw 'telephone' stays
                E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identifiers, grouped under a nested object in
                version 2: the memberId, householdId and identityKey. Each is
                rederived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2'
                version tag, so no value produced under version 1 is produced
                again.
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentity'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed at create time. Points
                start at 0 and accumulate: 2 when an email is present, 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 when
                the owner's tenure is more than one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 fixed at
                create time, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points,
                2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read from the city using a
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived on read from the locality
                (region) using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the region is not in the
                table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived when a birthDate is supplied by
                computing the completed years from birthDate to the effective
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was given.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year containing the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by
                the calendar year it ends in, so a registrationDate in July to
                December belongs to the fiscal year ending the following year.
                Derived on read.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived on read and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or
                more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard
                capacity limit of 50), otherwise false. Assigned on create and
                never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but, at create time,
                shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of, set when possibleDuplicate is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants manual review, derived on read: set
                when any of the following holds — the owner is a possible
                duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the owner's email domain
                is disposable-adjacent (a subdomain of a known disposable domain,
                or one that shares its second-level name such as
                'mailinator.net'), or the owner's city is over its soft capacity
                (capacityWarning is true, i.e. the city held 40 or more owners at
                create time). False otherwise.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: >-
                Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner
                is false; DELETE /api/owners/{id} marks the owner deleted (true)
                and retains the record. Deleted owners are ignored by the create
                endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets
    OwnerIdentity:
      title: Owner identity
      description: >-
        The owner's derived identifiers, grouped together in version 2. Every
        value is rederived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2'
        version tag, so no value produced under version 1 is produced again. The
        'V2' tag appears only inside these identifiers, never in the user-facing
        locality, timezone or owner segment.
      type: object
      properties:
        memberId:
          title: Member ID
          description: >-
            The owner's unified member id, formatted '<REGION><FY><HASH8><CHK>'
            and assigned on create. REGION is the version-2 region code derived
            from the postcode (the plain postcode-to-region region, or 'UNKNOWN'
            when the postcode is absent or in no known range, with the fixed 'V2'
            version tag mixed in). FY is the last two digits of the fiscal year
            containing the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. HASH8 is the
            first 8 upper-case hex characters of SHA-256 over normalizedTelephone
            + lastName. CHK is a single Luhn check digit computed over the digits
            of <REGION><FY><HASH8>. On the rare collision with an existing member
            id, '-<n>' is appended (smallest n of 2 or more) so member ids stay
            distinct.
          type: string
          example: 'V2NSW263A7F1C2D4'
          readOnly: true
        householdId:
          title: Household ID
          description: >-
            A stable shared identifier for owners who live in the same household,
            keyed on (lastName, postcode). It is deterministic: the first 12 hex
            characters of SHA-256 over the fixed 'V2' version tag +
            normalizedLastName + '|' + postcode, so owners with the same lastName
            and postcode always receive the same value. Assigned to every owner
            on create.
          type: string
          example: 'e6b1c2d40f3a'
          readOnly: true
        identityKey:
          title: Identity key
          description: >-
            The owner's derived identity key: the lower-case hex SHA-256 over the
            fixed 'V2' version tag + normalizedTelephone + '|' + (email or empty)
            + '|' + soundex(lastName), where the telephone is the stored E.164
            form and the email is lower-cased (empty when absent). Duplicate
            detection on create is keyed on this value.
          type: string
          example: 'a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2c3d4e5f6a1b2'
          readOnly: true

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: >-
            An optional honorific for the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it is combined with the lastName to form the
            salutation. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: 'DR'
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: >-
            The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. When a
            non-blank value is supplied the structured form is preferred over the
            flat 'address' input. Normalized on create (trim, collapse
            whitespace, upper-case, expand ST->STREET, RD->ROAD, AVE->AVENUE).
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: >-
            The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal
            address. Normalized on create the same way as addressLine1 and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apartment 4B'
        address:
          title: Address
          description: >-
            The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility, but when structured fields are supplied
            (a non-blank addressLine1) it is derived and returned as the
            composed value: the normalized addressLine1, with a single space and
            the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is present.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner. On create the value is
            normalized to E.164 form: spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped;
            a leading '+' and country code are kept when present, otherwise
            country code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped
            from the national digits; the result must have 8 to 15 digits after
            the '+'. The E.164 string (e.g. '+61412345678') is stored and returned.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must
            be a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned
            lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: >-
            The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional on create; when omitted it defaults to the server's current
            date. The effective date must fall on a business day: if it lands on
            a Saturday or Sunday it is rolled forward to the following Monday, and
            that adjusted date is what is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2013-01-01'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: >-
            The date of birth of the pet owner, in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
            Optional; when supplied it is used to derive the owner's ageBand,
            computed against the effective registrationDate.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The postcode of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be
            four digits and, for a city with a known region (Sydney=NSW
            2000-2099, Melbourne=VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane=QLD 4000-4099), fall
            within that region's inclusive range. A city with no known region
            accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: "^[0-9]{4}$"
          example: '2000'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only opt-in flag for create. The household is keyed on
            (lastName, postcode), so a second owner sharing an existing owner's
            lastName and postcode is a household duplicate and is rejected 409.
            When true this flag bypasses that block, creating the owner as a
            declared household member (which is not flagged as a possible
            duplicate). It does not itself create the household link — the shared
            householdId is derived deterministically from lastName and postcode.
            Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          default: false
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            apiVersion:
              title: API version
              description: >-
                The version of the owner API response shape. Fixed at 2: the
                identifiers are grouped under the nested 'identity' object and
                are derived with the version-2 algorithm.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: >-
                The canonical API path to this owner, derived on read as
                '/api/owners/' followed by the owner's id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/1'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: >-
                The owner's salutation, derived on read: the title followed by a
                single space and the lastName when a title is supplied, otherwise
                just the lastName.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: >-
                The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans: the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g.
                '+61 412 345 678'). Derived on read; the raw 'telephone' stays
                E.164.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: >-
                The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            identity:
              title: Identity
              description: >-
                The owner's derived identifiers, grouped under a nested object in
                version 2: the memberId, householdId and identityKey. Each is
                rederived with a version-2 algorithm that mixes in a fixed 'V2'
                version tag, so no value produced under version 1 is produced
                again.
              allOf:
                - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerIdentifiers'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: >-
                The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was
                created, shared the same firstName and lastName (compared
                case-insensitively). Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: >-
                The owner's membership points, fixed at create time. Points
                start at 0 and accumulate: 2 when an email is present, 1 when
                namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household of 3 or more, and 3 when
                the owner's tenure is more than one elapsed fiscal year.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: >-
                The owner's membership level, a number from 1 to 4 fixed at
                create time, derived from membershipPoints: 1 for 0-1 points,
                2 for 2-3, 3 for 4-5, and 4 for 6 or more.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: >-
                The owner's locality, derived on read from the city using a
                fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC,
                Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: >-
                The owner's IANA timezone, derived on read from the locality
                (region) using a fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->
                Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Null when the region is not in the
                table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: >-
                The owner's preferred contact channel, derived on read:
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - EMAIL
                - PHONE
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: >-
                The owner's age band, derived when a birthDate is supplied by
                computing the completed years from birthDate to the effective
                registrationDate: 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' when 18 to 64,
                and 'SENIOR' when 65 or older. Null when no birthDate was given.
              type: string
              enum:
                - MINOR
                - ADULT
                - SENIOR
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: >-
                The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>' where YY is the last
                two digits of the fiscal year containing the business-day-adjusted
                registrationDate. The fiscal year starts on 1 July and is named by
                the calendar year it ends in, so a registrationDate in July to
                December belongs to the fiscal year ending the following year.
                Derived on read.
              type: string
              example: 'FY26'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: >-
                The owner's segment, derived on read and formatted
                '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is 'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or
                more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO' when the locality is
                a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              enum:
                - PREMIUM_METRO
                - PREMIUM_REGIONAL
                - STANDARD_METRO
                - STANDARD_REGIONAL
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: >-
                True when more than 80 owners had already been created on this
                owner's registration date at the time this owner was created,
                otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: >-
                True when, at the time this owner was created, the owner's city
                already held between 40 and 49 owners (approaching the hard
                capacity limit of 50), otherwise false. Assigned on create and
                never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: >-
                True when this owner is not a hard duplicate but, at create time,
                shared an existing owner's lastName and postcode with a different
                telephone; otherwise false. Assigned on create and never changes.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: >-
                The id of the existing owner this owner is a possible duplicate
                of, set when possibleDuplicate is true; null otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 7
              readOnly: true
            riskFlag:
              title: Risk flag
              description: >-
                True when the owner warrants manual review, derived on read: set
                when any of the following holds — the owner is a possible
                duplicate (possibleDuplicate is true), the owner's email domain
                is disposable-adjacent (a subdomain of a known disposable domain,
